data.name: [UPD] +1 Banana Monkey Destruction
data.description:
🐵 Welcome to +1 Banana Monkey Destruction!
⏰ Don't forget to come back every day to claim the free trainer!

💥 Punch and destroy anything that comes your way
🍌 Collect bananas to get bigger and stronger
💸 Upgrade your stats to become even stronger
🌍 Become OP and DESTROY the entire WORLD!

😎 100% satisfaction is guaranteed
👍 Don't forget to leave a like on the game!

⚠️ This game is still new! Please be patient with updates and expect bugs.
